info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Assigns-v2-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Assignment API allows users to list all support tickets that have been assigned to them or their team. This endpoint is crucial for customer support professionals who need real-time access to ticket statuses and assignments. By utilizing this API, support agents can efficiently manage their workload and prioritize responses to customers. Typical consumers include customer support teams and service managers seeking to monitor and optimize ticket resolution workflows.

get.description: This operation allows you to fetch the list of tickets that can be assigned to users. It provides insights into the current status and details of each ticket, enabling efficient ticket allocation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to assign tickets to a user. It requires the necessary information regarding the ticket and the user to whom it should be assigned.

ListSupportTicketsAssignsRequest.description: The request body for the operation to assign tickets, represented as a string.

ListSupportTicketsAssignsResponse_201.title: Ticket Assignment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the ticket assignment was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the ticket assignment.

resultId.description: Identifier of the result associated with the ticket assignment.

state.description: Current state of the ticket after the assignment operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the assignment request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message related to the ticket assignment operation.

audit.description: Details of the audit for the ticket assignment.

ListSupportTicketsAssignsResponse_201.description: Response schema for ticket assignment operations that indicates the status and details of the operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the ticket assignment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the ticket assignment was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the ticket assignment was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Contains information about the creation and automation of the ticket assignment.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
